summary: CRITICAL: Deliverable is incomplete. Source code is well-typed with good error handling, but task explicitly requires act-based test harness (ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT, create act-result.txt, assert exact output values, run actionlint) — none of this infrastructure is present. Missing: test files (cleanup.test.ts, format.test.ts, config.test.ts, cli.test.ts), fixture files (basic.json, size-pressure.json, etc.), act harness loop, actionlint step, act-result.txt generation. Workflow references nonexistent fixtures; fixture loop hardcoded without parameterization. Bash step lacks `set -euo pipefail`. Without tests and act integration, delivery is unverifiable and incomplete against explicit requirements.
